notes: All nutritional values are approximate per 100g serving (or per cup for beverages) based on FAO/WHO food composition data for Sub-Saharan Africa
Values may vary based on preparation method, recipe, and ingredient sourcing
Traditional Kenyan vegetables (managu, terere, kunde) are exceptionally nutritious and underutilized
Omena (small Lake Victoria fish) is one of Kenya's most nutrient-dense foods per 100g
Ugali + sukuma wiki + beans forms a nutritionally complete meal and is Kenya's most affordable balanced diet
Data compiled from FAO food composition tables, KEMRI nutritional studies, and Kenya Agricultural Research Institute
